English: Weapon Shed
A simple timber lean-to or tent near the palisade, storing basic arms for the levy in times of need.
Arms Locker
A locked timber structure with racks and chests for storing better-maintained weaponry and basic armor for defenders.
Smithy Store
A modest stone outbuilding near the blacksmith, used for storing and issuing newly-forged arms and armor for the garrison.
Armament Room
A fortified stone chamber within the curtain wall, well-organized for rapid arming of troops in emergencies.
Stone Armory
A large, stone-vaulted armory with secure doors, racks, and climate control to keep weapons in peak condition.
Secure Armory
A reinforced, guarded vault deep within the keep, with strict inventory and guards, ensuring no arms are stolen or lost.
Expanded Armory
A sprawling complex of interconnected storerooms, allowing the castle to equip a host for prolonged campaigns.
Ordnance Depot
A vast, organized arsenal containing not only melee arms but siege equipment, armor for hundreds, and specialized weaponry.
Grand Arsenal
A monumental fortified complex housing weapon stores, workshops, and training yards—centerpiece of the castle’s might.
Royal Armory
A legendary stronghold, bristling with the finest arms, armor, and siege engines, every defender is a paragon of war.
